head.t: FDA clears Medtronic's Hugo robot for general surgery
head.x: FDA has cleared Medtronic's Hugo robotic-assisted system for upper abdominal general surgery (e.g. small bowel resection, cholecystectomy, ventral hernia repair) plus appendectomy and inguinal hernia repair, beyond its prior urology indications.

head.t: Medtronic to acquire Contego Medical (Neuroguard carotid systems, Excipio thrombectomy) for $380m
head.x: Medtronic announced on 16/11/2026 that it will acquire Contego Medical, a privately held company, valued at $380m with potential payments post-acquisition.

Medtronic today announced its intent to acquire Contego Medical. A press release notes that the acquisition will build on Medtronic’s US distribution agreement with Contego, first announced in January 2025.

f.t: TCT 2026: Medtronic outlines trial of TAVI in moderate aortic stenosis
f.x: Study design and baseline characteristics of patients enrolled in the Evolut EXPAND TAVR II trial were presented today as featured clinical science at the Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) conference (31 October–3 November, San Diego, USA).

f.t: Medtronic announces positive real-world results on Sphere-9 catheter and PulseSelect PFA system at APHRS 2026
f.x: Medtronic has announced positive real-world registry results for the Affera mapping and ablation system with the Sphere-9 catheter and the PulseSelect pulsed field ablation (PFA) system.
